verses.text: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
verses.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus Christ

verses.text: Abraham was the father of Isaac, and Isaac the father of Jacob, and Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers,
verses.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus Christ

verses.text: and Judah the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar, and Perez the father of Hezron, and Hezron the father of Ram,
verses.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus Christ

verses.text: and Ram the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon the father of Salmon,
verses.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus Christ

verses.text: and Salmon the father of Boaz by Rahab, and Boaz the father of Obed by Ruth, and Obed the father of Jesse,
verses.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus Christ

verses.text: and Jesse the father of David the king. And David was the father of Solomon by the wife of Uriah,
verses.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus Christ

verses.text: and Solomon the father of Rehoboam, and Rehoboam the father of Abijah, and Abijah the father of Asa,
verses.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus Christ

verses.text: and Asa the father of Jehoshaphat, and Jehoshaphat the father of Joram, and Joram the father of Uzziah,
verses.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus Christ

verses.text: and Uzziah the father of Jotham, and Jotham the father of Ahaz, and Ahaz the father of Hezekiah,
verses.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus Christ

verses.text: and Hezekiah the father of Manasseh, and Manasseh the father of Amos, and Amos the father of Josiah,
verses.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus Christ

verses.text: and Josiah the father of Jechoniah and his brothers, at the time of the deportation to Babylon.
verses.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus Christ

verses.text: And after the deportation to Babylon: Jechoniah was the father of She-alti-el, and Shealti-el the father of Zerubbabel,
verses.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus Christ

verses.text: and Zerubbabel the father of Abiud, and Abiud the father of Eliakim, and Eliakim the father of Azor,
verses.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus Christ

verses.text: and Azor the father of Zadok, and Zadok the father of Achim, and Achim the father of Eliud,
verses.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus Christ

verses.text: and Eliud the father of Eleazar, and Eleazar the father of Matthan, and Matthan the father of Jacob,
verses.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus Christ

verses.text: and Jacob the father of Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom Jesus was born, who is called Christ.
verses.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus Christ

verses.text: So all the generations from Abraham to David were fourteen generations, and from David to the deportation to Babylon fourteen generations, and from the deportation to Babylon to the Christ fourteen generations.
verses.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus Christ

verses.text: Now the birth of Jesus Christ took place in this way. When his mother Mary had been betrothed to Joseph, before they came together she was found to be with child of the Holy Spirit;
verses.heading: The Birth of Jesus Christ

verses.text: and her husband Joseph, being a just man and unwilling to put her to shame, resolved to send her away quietly.
verses.heading: The Birth of Jesus Christ

verses.text: But as he considered this, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, do not fear to take Mary your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit;
verses.heading: The Birth of Jesus Christ

verses.text: she will bear a son, and you shall call his name Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins.”
verses.heading: The Birth of Jesus Christ

verses.text: All this took place to fulfil what the Lord had spoken by the prophet:
verses.heading: The Birth of Jesus Christ

verses.text: “Behold, a virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and his name shall be called Emmanuel” (which means, God with us).
verses.heading: The Birth of Jesus Christ

verses.text: When Joseph woke from sleep, he did as the angel of the Lord commanded him; he took his wife,
verses.heading: The Birth of Jesus Christ

verses.text: but knew her not until she had borne a son; and he called his name Jesus.
verses.heading: The Birth of Jesus Christ

headings.title: The Visit of the Wise Men

verses.text: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king, behold, Wise Men from the East came to Jerusalem, saying,
verses.heading: The Visit of the Wise Men

verses.text: “Where is he who has been born king of the Jews? For we have seen his star in the East, and have come to worship him.”
verses.heading: The Visit of the Wise Men

verses.text: When Herod the king heard this, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him;
verses.heading: The Visit of the Wise Men

verses.text: and assembling all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he inquired of them where the Christ was to be born.
verses.heading: The Visit of the Wise Men

verses.text: They told him, “In Bethlehem of Judea; for so it is written by the prophet:
verses.heading: The Visit of the Wise Men

verses.text: ‘And you, O Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah; for from you shall come a ruler who will govern my people Israel.’”
verses.heading: The Visit of the Wise Men

verses.text: Then Herod summoned the Wise Men secretly and ascertained from them what time the star appeared;
verses.heading: The Visit of the Wise Men

verses.text: and he sent them to Bethlehem, saying, “Go and search diligently for the child, and when you have found him bring me word, that I too may come and worship him.”
verses.heading: The Visit of the Wise Men

verses.text: When they had heard the king they went their way; and behold, the star which they had seen in the East went before them, till it came to rest over the place where the child was.
verses.heading: The Visit of the Wise Men

verses.text: When they saw the star, they rejoiced exceedingly with great joy;
verses.heading: The Visit of the Wise Men

verses.text: and going into the house they saw the child with Mary his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Then, opening their treasures, they offered him gifts, gold and frankincense and myrrh.
verses.heading: The Visit of the Wise Men

verses.text: And being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they departed to their own country by another way.
verses.heading: The Visit of the Wise Men

verses.text: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, “Rise, take the child and his mother, and flee to Egypt, and remain there till I tell you; for Herod is about to search for the child, to destroy him.”
verses.heading: The Escape to Egypt

verses.text: And he rose and took the child and his mother by night, and departed to Egypt,
verses.heading: The Escape to Egypt

verses.text: and remained there until the death of Herod. This was to fulfil what the Lord had spoken by the prophet, “Out of Egypt have I called my son.”
verses.heading: The Escape to Egypt

verses.text: Then Herod, when he saw that he had been tricked by the Wise Men, was in a furious rage, and he sent and killed all the male children in Bethlehem and in all that region who were two years old or under, according to the time which he had ascertained from the Wise Men.
verses.heading: The Escape to Egypt

verses.text: Then was fulfilled what was spoken by the prophet Jeremiah:
verses.heading: The Escape to Egypt

verses.text: “A voice was heard in Ramah, wailing and loud lamentation, Rachel weeping for her children; she refused to be consoled, because they were no more.”
verses.heading: The Escape to Egypt

verses.text: But when Herod died, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,
verses.heading: The Return from Egypt

verses.text: “Rise, take the child and his mother, and go to the land of Israel, for those who sought the child’s life are dead.”
verses.heading: The Return from Egypt

verses.text: And he rose and took the child and his mother, and went to the land of Israel.
verses.heading: The Return from Egypt

verses.text: But when he heard that Archelaus reigned over Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there, and being warned in a dream he withdrew to the district of Galilee.
verses.heading: The Return from Egypt

verses.text: And he went and dwelt in a city called Nazareth, that what was spoken by the prophets might be fulfilled. “He shall be called a Nazarene.”
verses.heading: The Return from Egypt

headings.title: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judea,
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.”
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: For this is he who was spoken of by the prophet Isaiah when he said, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.”
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: Now John wore a garment of camel’s hair, and a leather belt around his waist; and his food was locusts and wild honey.
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: Then went out to him Jerusalem and all Judea and all the region about the Jordan,
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: and they were baptized by him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for baptism, he said to them, “You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: Bear fruit that befits repentance,
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: and do not presume to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father’; for I tell you, God is able from these stones to raise up children to Abraham.
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: Even now the axe is laid to the root of the trees; every tree therefore that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: “I baptize you with water for repentance, but he who is coming after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry; he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will clear his threshing floor and gather his wheat into the granary, but the chaff he will burn with unquenchable fire.”
verses.heading: The Preaching of John the Baptist

verses.text: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.
verses.heading: The Baptism of Jesus

verses.text: John would have prevented him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and do you come to me?”
verses.heading: The Baptism of Jesus

verses.text: But Jesus answered him, “Let it be so now; for thus it is fitting for us to fulfil all righteousness.” Then he consented.
verses.heading: The Baptism of Jesus

verses.text: And when Jesus was baptized, he went up immediately from the water, and behold, the heavens were opened and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and alighting on him;
verses.heading: The Baptism of Jesus

verses.text: and behold, a voice from heaven, saying, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
verses.heading: The Baptism of Jesus

headings.title: Jesus Ministers to Crowds of People

verses.text: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
verses.heading: The Temptation of Jesus

verses.text: And he fasted forty days and forty nights, and afterward he was hungry.
verses.heading: The Temptation of Jesus

verses.text: And the tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command these stones to become loaves of bread.”
verses.heading: The Temptation of Jesus

verses.text: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds from the mouth of God.’”
verses.heading: The Temptation of Jesus

verses.text: Then the devil took him to the holy city, and set him on the pinnacle of the temple,
verses.heading: The Temptation of Jesus

verses.text: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down; for it is written, ‘He will give his angels charge of you,’ and ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest you strike your foot against a stone.’”
verses.heading: The Temptation of Jesus

verses.text: Jesus said to him, “Again it is written, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”
verses.heading: The Temptation of Jesus

verses.text: Again, the devil took him to a very high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and the glory of them;
verses.heading: The Temptation of Jesus

verses.text: and he said to him, “All these I will give you, if you will fall down and worship me.”
verses.heading: The Temptation of Jesus

verses.text: Then Jesus said to him, “Begone, Satan! for it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God and him only shall you serve.’”
verses.heading: The Temptation of Jesus

verses.text: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and ministered to him.
verses.heading: The Temptation of Jesus

verses.text: Now when he heard that John had been arrested, he withdrew into Galilee;
verses.heading: Jesus Begins Preaching in Galilee

verses.text: and leaving Nazareth he went and dwelt in Caperna-um by the sea, in the territory of Zebulun and Naphtali,
verses.heading: Jesus Begins Preaching in Galilee

verses.text: that what was spoken by the prophet Isaiah might be fulfilled:
verses.heading: Jesus Begins Preaching in Galilee

verses.text: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, across the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles—
verses.heading: Jesus Begins Preaching in Galilee

verses.text: the people who sat in darkness have seen a great light, and for those who sat in the region and shadow of death light has dawned.”
verses.heading: Jesus Begins Preaching in Galilee

verses.text: From that time Jesus began to preach, saying, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.”
verses.heading: Jesus Begins Preaching in Galilee

verses.text: As he walked by the Sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon who is called Peter and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
verses.heading: Jesus Calls the First Disciples

verses.text: And he said to them, “Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.”
verses.heading: Jesus Calls the First Disciples

verses.text: Immediately they left their nets and followed him.
verses.heading: Jesus Calls the First Disciples

verses.text: And going on from there he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets, and he called them.
verses.heading: Jesus Calls the First Disciples

verses.text: Immediately they left the boat and their father, and followed him.
verses.heading: Jesus Calls the First Disciples

verses.text: And he went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the gospel of the kingdom and healing every disease and every infirmity among the people.
verses.heading: Jesus Ministers to Crowds of People

verses.text: So his fame spread throughout all Syria, and they brought him all the sick, those afflicted with various diseases and pains, demoniacs, epileptics, and paralytics, and he healed them.
verses.heading: Jesus Ministers to Crowds of People

verses.text: And great crowds followed him from Galilee and the Decapolis and Jerusalem and Judea and from beyond the Jordan.
verses.heading: Jesus Ministers to Crowds of People

headings.title: The Fulfillment of the Law and the Prophets

verses.text: Seeing the crowds, he went up on the mountain, and when he sat down his disciples came to him.
verses.heading: The Beatitudes

verses.text: And he opened his mouth and taught them, saying:
verses.heading: The Beatitudes

verses.text: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.heading: The Beatitudes

verses.text: “Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
verses.heading: The Beatitudes

verses.text: “Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.heading: The Beatitudes

verses.text: “Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be satisfied.
verses.heading: The Beatitudes

verses.text: “Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
verses.heading: The Beatitudes

verses.text: “Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
verses.heading: The Beatitudes

verses.text: “Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called sons of God.
verses.heading: The Beatitudes

verses.text: “Blessed are those who are persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.heading: The Beatitudes

verses.text: “Blessed are you when men revile you and persecute you and utter all kinds of evil against you falsely on my account.
verses.heading: The Beatitudes

verses.text: Rejoice and be glad, for your reward is great in heaven, for so men persecuted the prophets who were before you.
verses.heading: The Beatitudes

verses.text: “You are the salt of the earth; but if salt has lost its taste, how shall its saltiness be restored? It is no longer good for anything except to be thrown out and trodden under foot by men.
verses.heading: Salt and Light

verses.text: “You are the light of the world. A city set on a hill cannot be hidden.
verses.heading: Salt and Light

verses.text: Nor do men light a lamp and put it under a bushel, but on a stand, and it gives light to all in the house.
verses.heading: Salt and Light

verses.text: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father who is in heaven.
verses.heading: Salt and Light

verses.text: “Do not think that I have come to abolish the law and the prophets; I have come not to abolish them but to fulfil them.
verses.heading: The Fulfillment of the Law and the Prophets

verses.text: For truly, I say to you, till heaven and earth pass away, not an iota, not a dot, will pass from the law until all is accomplished.
verses.heading: The Fulfillment of the Law and the Prophets

verses.text: Whoever then relaxes one of the least of these commandments and teaches men so, shall be called least in the kingdom of heaven; but he who does them and teaches them shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.heading: The Fulfillment of the Law and the Prophets

verses.text: For I tell you, unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
verses.heading: The Fulfillment of the Law and the Prophets

verses.text: “You have heard that it was said to the men of old, ‘You shall not kill; and whoever kills shall be liable to judgment.’
verses.heading: Concerning Anger

verses.text: But I say to you that every one who is angry with his brother shall be liable to judgment; whoever insults his brother shall be liable to the council, and whoever says, ‘You fool!’ shall be liable to the hell of fire.
verses.heading: Concerning Anger

verses.text: So if you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has something against you,
verses.heading: Concerning Anger

verses.text: leave your gift there before the altar and go; first be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.
verses.heading: Concerning Anger

verses.text: Make friends quickly with your accuser, while you are going with him to court, lest your accuser hand you over to the judge, and the judge to the guard, and you be put in prison;
verses.heading: Concerning Anger

verses.text: truly, I say to you, you will never get out till you have paid the last penny.
verses.heading: Concerning Anger

verses.text: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery.’
verses.heading: Concerning Adultery

verses.text: But I say to you that every one who looks at a woman lustfully has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
verses.heading: Concerning Adultery

verses.text: If your right eye causes you to sin, pluck it out and throw it away; it is better that you lose one of your members than that your whole body be thrown into hell.
verses.heading: Concerning Adultery

verses.text: And if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away; it is better that you lose one of your members than that your whole body go into hell.
verses.heading: Concerning Adultery

verses.text: “It was also said, ‘Whoever divorces his wife, let him give her a certificate of divorce.’
verses.heading: Concerning Divorce

verses.text: But I say to you that every one who divorces his wife, except on the ground of unchastity, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
verses.heading: Concerning Divorce

verses.text: “Again you have heard that it was said to the men of old, ‘You shall not swear falsely, but shall perform to the Lord what you have sworn.’
verses.heading: Concerning Swearing Oaths

verses.text: But I say to you, Do not swear at all, either by heaven, for it is the throne of God,
verses.heading: Concerning Swearing Oaths

verses.text: or by the earth, for it is his footstool, or by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
verses.heading: Concerning Swearing Oaths

verses.text: And do not swear by your head, for you cannot make one hair white or black.
verses.heading: Concerning Swearing Oaths

verses.text: Let what you say be simply ‘Yes’ or ‘No’; anything more than this comes from the Evil One.
verses.heading: Concerning Swearing Oaths

verses.text: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.’
verses.heading: Concerning Retaliation

verses.text: But I say to you, Do not resist one who is evil. But if any one strikes you on the right cheek, turn to him the other also;
verses.heading: Concerning Retaliation

verses.text: and if any one would sue you and take your coat, let him have your cloak as well;
verses.heading: Concerning Retaliation

verses.text: and if any one forces you to go one mile, go with him two miles.
verses.heading: Concerning Retaliation

verses.text: Give to him who begs from you, and do not refuse him who would borrow from you.
verses.heading: Concerning Retaliation

verses.text: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
verses.heading: Love for Enemies

verses.text: But I say to you, Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,
verses.heading: Love for Enemies

verses.text: so that you may be sons of your Father who is in heaven; for he makes his sun rise on the evil and on the good, and sends rain on the just and on the unjust.
verses.heading: Love for Enemies

verses.text: For if you love those who love you, what reward have you? Do not even the tax collectors do the same?
verses.heading: Love for Enemies

verses.text: And if you salute only your brethren, what more are you doing than others? Do not even the Gentiles do the same?
verses.heading: Love for Enemies

verses.text: You, therefore, must be perfect, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
verses.heading: Love for Enemies

verses.text: “Beware of practicing your piety before men in order to be seen by them; for then you will have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.
verses.heading: Concerning Almsgiving

verses.text: “Thus, when you give alms, sound no trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may be praised by men. Truly, I say to you, they have their reward.
verses.heading: Concerning Almsgiving

verses.text: But when you give alms, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,
verses.heading: Concerning Almsgiving

verses.text: so that your alms may be in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you.
verses.heading: Concerning Almsgiving

verses.text: “And when you pray, you must not be like the hypocrites; for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and at the street corners, that they may be seen by men. Truly, I say to you, they have their reward.
verses.heading: Concerning Prayer

verses.text: But when you pray, go into your room and shut the door and pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you.
verses.heading: Concerning Prayer

verses.text: “And in praying do not heap up empty phrases as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their many words.
verses.heading: Concerning Prayer

verses.text: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask him.
verses.heading: Concerning Prayer

verses.text: Pray then like this: Our Father who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
verses.heading: Concerning Prayer

verses.text: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done On earth as it is in heaven.
verses.heading: Concerning Prayer

verses.text: Give us this day our daily bread;
verses.heading: Concerning Prayer

verses.text: And forgive us our trespasses As we forgive those who trespass against us;
verses.heading: Concerning Prayer

verses.text: And lead us not into temptation, But deliver us from evil.
verses.heading: Concerning Prayer

verses.text: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father also will forgive you;
verses.heading: Concerning Prayer

verses.text: but if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
verses.heading: Concerning Prayer

verses.text: “And when you fast, do not look dismal, like the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces that their fasting may be seen by men. Truly, I say to you, they have their reward.
verses.heading: Concerning Fasting

verses.text: But when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,
verses.heading: Concerning Fasting

verses.text: that your fasting may not be seen by men but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you.
verses.heading: Concerning Fasting

verses.text: “Do not lay up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust consume and where thieves break in and steal,
verses.heading: Concerning Treasures

verses.text: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consumes and where thieves do not break in and steal.
verses.heading: Concerning Treasures

verses.text: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
verses.heading: Concerning Treasures

verses.text: “The eye is the lamp of the body. So, if your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light;
verses.heading: The Sound Eye

verses.text: but if your eye is not sound, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!
verses.heading: The Sound Eye

verses.text: “No one can serve two masters; for either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and mammon.
verses.heading: Serving Two Masters

verses.text: “Therefore I tell you, do not be anxious about your life, what you shall eat or what you shall drink, nor about your body, what you shall put on. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothing?
verses.heading: Do Not Be Anxious

verses.text: Look at the birds of the air: they neither sow nor reap nor gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not of more value than they?
verses.heading: Do Not Be Anxious

verses.text: And which of you by being anxious can add one cubit to his span of life?
verses.heading: Do Not Be Anxious

verses.text: And why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they neither toil nor spin;
verses.heading: Do Not Be Anxious

verses.text: yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not clothed like one of these.
verses.heading: Do Not Be Anxious

verses.text: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today is alive and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, will he not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
verses.heading: Do Not Be Anxious

verses.text: Therefore do not be anxious, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’
verses.heading: Do Not Be Anxious

verses.text: For the Gentiles seek all these things; and your heavenly Father knows that you need them all.
verses.heading: Do Not Be Anxious

verses.text: But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things shall be yours as well.
verses.heading: Do Not Be Anxious

verses.text: “Therefore do not be anxious about tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Let the day’s own trouble be sufficient for the day.
verses.heading: Do Not Be Anxious

verses.text: “Judge not, that you be not judged.
verses.heading: Judging Others

verses.text: For with the judgment you pronounce you will be judged, and the measure you give will be the measure you get.
verses.heading: Judging Others

verses.text: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but do not notice the log that is in your own eye?
verses.heading: Judging Others

verses.text: Or how can you say to your brother, ‘Let me take the speck out of your eye,’ when there is the log in your own eye?
verses.heading: Judging Others

verses.text: You hypocrite, first take the log out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to take the speck out of your brother’s eye.
verses.heading: Judging Others

verses.text: “Do not give dogs what is holy; and do not throw your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under foot and turn to attack you.
verses.heading: Profaning the Holy

verses.text: “Ask, and it will be given you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.
verses.heading: Ask, Seek, Knock

verses.text: For every one who asks receives, and he who seeks finds, and to him who knocks it will be opened.
verses.heading: Ask, Seek, Knock

verses.text: Or what man of you, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?
verses.heading: Ask, Seek, Knock

verses.text: Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a serpent?
verses.heading: Ask, Seek, Knock

verses.text: If you then, who are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
verses.heading: Ask, Seek, Knock

verses.text: So whatever you wish that men would do to you, do so to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
verses.heading: Ask, Seek, Knock

verses.text: “Enter by the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is easy, that leads to destruction, and those who enter by it are many.
verses.heading: The Narrow Gate

verses.text: For the gate is narrow and the way is hard, that leads to life, and those who find it are few.
verses.heading: The Narrow Gate

verses.text: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing but inwardly are ravenous wolves.
verses.heading: False Prophets

verses.text: You will know them by their fruits. Are grapes gathered from thorns, or figs from thistles?
verses.heading: False Prophets

verses.text: So, every sound tree bears good fruit, but the bad tree bears evil fruit.
verses.heading: False Prophets

verses.text: A sound tree cannot bear evil fruit, nor can a bad tree bear good fruit.
verses.heading: False Prophets

verses.text: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
verses.heading: False Prophets

verses.text: Thus you will know them by their fruits.
verses.heading: False Prophets

verses.text: “Not every one who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ shall enter the kingdom of heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.
verses.heading: Concerning Self-Deception

verses.text: On that day many will say to me, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in your name, and cast out demons in your name, and do many mighty works in your name?’
verses.heading: Concerning Self-Deception

verses.text: And then will I declare to them, ‘I never knew you; depart from me, you evildoers.’
verses.heading: Concerning Self-Deception

verses.text: “Every one then who hears these words of mine and does them will be like a wise man who built his house upon the rock;
verses.heading: Hearers and Doers

verses.text: and the rain fell, and the floods came, and the winds blew and beat upon that house, but it did not fall, because it had been founded on the rock.
verses.heading: Hearers and Doers

verses.text: And every one who hears these words of mine and does not do them will be like a foolish man who built his house upon the sand;
verses.heading: Hearers and Doers

verses.text: and the rain fell, and the floods came, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell; and great was the fall of it.”
verses.heading: Hearers and Doers

verses.text: And when Jesus finished these sayings, the crowds were astonished at his teaching,
verses.heading: Hearers and Doers

verses.text: for he taught them as one who had authority, and not as their scribes.
verses.heading: Hearers and Doers

headings.title: Jesus Heals Many at Peter’s House
Jesus Calms the Storm at Sea

verses.text: When he came down from the mountain, great crowds followed him;
verses.heading: Jesus Cleanses a Leper

verses.text: and behold, a leper came to him and knelt before him, saying, “Lord, if you will, you can make me clean.”
verses.heading: Jesus Cleanses a Leper

verses.text: And he stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I will; be clean.” And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
verses.heading: Jesus Cleanses a Leper

verses.text: And Jesus said to him, “See that you say nothing to any one; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a proof to the people.”
verses.heading: Jesus Cleanses a Leper

verses.text: As he entered Caperna-um, a centurion came forward to him, begging him
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Centurion’s Servant

verses.text: and saying, “Lord, my servant is lying paralyzed at home, in terrible distress.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Centurion’s Servant

verses.text: And he said to him, “I will come and heal him.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Centurion’s Servant

verses.text: But the centurion answered him, “Lord, I am not worthy to have you come under my roof; but only say the word, and my servant will be healed.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Centurion’s Servant

verses.text: For I am a man under authority, with soldiers under me; and I say to one, ‘Go,’ and he goes, and to another, ‘Come,’ and he comes, and to my slave, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Centurion’s Servant

verses.text: When Jesus heard him, he marveled, and said to those who followed him, “Truly, I say to you, not even in Israel have I found such faith.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Centurion’s Servant

verses.text: I tell you, many will come from east and west and sit at table with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven,
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Centurion’s Servant

verses.text: while the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness; there men will weep and gnash their teeth.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Centurion’s Servant

verses.text: And to the centurion Jesus said, “Go; let it be done for you as you have believed.” And the servant was healed at that very moment.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Centurion’s Servant

verses.text: And when Jesus entered Peter’s house, he saw his mother-in-law lying sick with a fever;
verses.heading: Jesus Heals Many at Peter’s House

verses.text: he touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she rose and served him.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals Many at Peter’s House

verses.text: That evening they brought to him many who were possessed with demons; and he cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals Many at Peter’s House

verses.text: This was to fulfil what was spoken by the prophet Isaiah, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals Many at Peter’s House

verses.text: Now when Jesus saw great crowds around him, he gave orders to go over to the other side.
verses.heading: Would-be Followers of Jesus

verses.text: And a scribe came up and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”
verses.heading: Would-be Followers of Jesus

verses.text: And Jesus said to him, “Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man has nowhere to lay his head.”
verses.heading: Would-be Followers of Jesus

verses.text: Another of the disciples said to him, “Lord, let me first go and bury my father.”
verses.heading: Would-be Followers of Jesus

verses.text: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”
verses.heading: Would-be Followers of Jesus

verses.text: And when he got into the boat, his disciples followed him.
verses.heading: Jesus Calms the Storm at Sea

verses.text: And behold, there arose a great storm on the sea, so that the boat was being swamped by the waves; but he was asleep.
verses.heading: Jesus Calms the Storm at Sea

verses.text: And they went and woke him, saying, “Save us, Lord; we are perishing.”
verses.heading: Jesus Calms the Storm at Sea

verses.text: And he said to them, “Why are you afraid, O men of little faith?” Then he rose and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
verses.heading: Jesus Calms the Storm at Sea

verses.text: And the men marveled, saying, “What sort of man is this, that even winds and sea obey him?”
verses.heading: Jesus Calms the Storm at Sea

verses.text: And when he came to the other side, to the country of the Gadarenes, two demoniacs met him, coming out of the tombs, so fierce that no one could pass that way.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gadarene Demoniacs

verses.text: And behold, they cried out, “What have you to do with us, O Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gadarene Demoniacs

verses.text: Now a herd of many swine was feeding at some distance from them.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gadarene Demoniacs

verses.text: And the demons begged him, “If you cast us out, send us away into the herd of swine.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gadarene Demoniacs

verses.text: And he said to them, “Go.” So they came out and went into the swine; and behold, the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and perished in the waters.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gadarene Demoniacs

verses.text: The herdsmen fled, and going into the city they told everything, and what had happened to the demoniacs.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gadarene Demoniacs

verses.text: And behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus; and when they saw him, they begged him to leave their neighborhood.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals the Gadarene Demoniacs

headings.title: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed
Jesus Heals a Man Who Was Mute
The Harvest Is Plentiful, the Laborers Are Few

verses.text: And getting into a boat he crossed over and came to his own city.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: And behold, they brought to him a paralytic, lying on his bed; and when Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, “Take heart, my son; your sins are forgiven.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: And behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man is blaspheming.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: But Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Rise and walk’?
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: But that you may know that the Son of man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he then said to the paralytic—“Rise, take up your bed and go home.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: And he rose and went home.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: When the crowds saw it, they were afraid, and they glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

verses.text: As Jesus passed on from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax office; and he said to him, “Follow me.” And he rose and followed him.
verses.heading: The Call of Matthew

verses.text: And as he sat at table in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.
verses.heading: The Call of Matthew

verses.text: And when the Pharisees saw this, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
verses.heading: The Call of Matthew

verses.text: But when he heard it, he said, “Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick.
verses.heading: The Call of Matthew

verses.text: Go and learn what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice.’ For I came not to call the righteous, but sinners.”
verses.heading: The Call of Matthew

verses.text: Then the disciples of John came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast, but your disciples do not fast?”
verses.heading: The Question about Fasting

verses.text: And Jesus said to them, “Can the wedding guests mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? The days will come, when the bridegroom is taken away from them, and then they will fast.
verses.heading: The Question about Fasting

verses.text: And no one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, for the patch tears away from the garment, and a worse tear is made.
verses.heading: The Question about Fasting

verses.text: Neither is new wine put into old wineskins; if it is, the skins burst, and the wine is spilled, and the skins are destroyed; but new wine is put into fresh wineskins, and so both are preserved.”
verses.heading: The Question about Fasting

verses.text: While he was thus speaking to them, behold, a ruler came in and knelt before him, saying, “My daughter has just died; but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: And Jesus rose and followed him, with his disciples.
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: And behold, a woman who had suffered from a hemorrhage for twelve years came up behind him and touched the fringe of his garment;
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: for she said to herself, “If I only touch his garment, I shall be made well.”
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: Jesus turned, and seeing her he said, “Take heart, daughter; your faith has made you well.” And instantly the woman was made well.
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: And when Jesus came to the ruler’s house, and saw the flute players, and the crowd making a tumult,
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: he said, “Depart; for the girl is not dead but sleeping.” And they laughed at him.
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: But when the crowd had been put outside, he went in and took her by the hand, and the girl arose.
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: And the report of this went through all that district.
verses.heading: A Girl Restored to Life and a Woman Healed

verses.text: And as Jesus passed on from there, two blind men followed him, crying aloud, “Have mercy on us, Son of David.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals Two Blind Men

verses.text: When he entered the house, the blind men came to him; and Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They said to him, “Yes, Lord.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals Two Blind Men

verses.text: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith let it be done to you.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals Two Blind Men

verses.text: And their eyes were opened. And Jesus sternly charged them, “See that no one knows it.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals Two Blind Men

verses.text: But they went away and spread his fame through all that district.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals Two Blind Men

verses.text: As they were going away, behold, a mute demoniac was brought to him.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Man Who Was Mute

verses.text: And when the demon had been cast out, the mute man spoke; and the crowds marveled, saying, “Never was anything like this seen in Israel.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Man Who Was Mute

verses.text: But the Pharisees said, “He casts out demons by the prince of demons.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals a Man Who Was Mute

verses.text: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and every infirmity.
verses.heading: The Harvest Is Plentiful, the Laborers Are Few

verses.text: When he saw the crowds, he had compassion for them, because they were harassed and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.
verses.heading: The Harvest Is Plentiful, the Laborers Are Few

verses.text: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest is plentiful, but the laborers are few;
verses.heading: The Harvest Is Plentiful, the Laborers Are Few

verses.text: pray therefore the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers into his harvest.”
verses.heading: The Harvest Is Plentiful, the Laborers Are Few

verses.text: And he called to him his twelve disciples and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every infirmity.
verses.heading: The Twelve Disciples

verses.text: The names of the twelve apostles are these: first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
verses.heading: The Twelve Disciples

verses.text: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;
verses.heading: The Twelve Disciples

verses.text: Simon the Cananaean, and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed him.
verses.heading: The Twelve Disciples

verses.text: These Twelve Jesus sent out, charging them, “Go nowhere among the Gentiles, and enter no town of the Samaritans,
verses.heading: The Mission of the Twelve

verses.text: but go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
verses.heading: The Mission of the Twelve

verses.text: And preach as you go, saying, ‘The kingdom of heaven is at hand.’
verses.heading: The Mission of the Twelve

verses.text: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse lepers, cast out demons. You received without pay, give without pay.
verses.heading: The Mission of the Twelve

verses.text: Take no gold, nor silver, nor copper in your belts,
verses.heading: The Mission of the Twelve

verses.text: no bag for your journey, nor two tunics, nor sandals, nor a staff; for the laborer deserves his food.
verses.heading: The Mission of the Twelve

verses.text: And whatever town or village you enter, find out who is worthy in it, and stay with him until you depart.
verses.heading: The Mission of the Twelve

verses.text: As you enter the house, salute it.
verses.heading: The Mission of the Twelve

verses.text: And if the house is worthy, let your peace come upon it; but if it is not worthy, let your peace return to you.
verses.heading: The Mission of the Twelve

verses.text: And if any one will not receive you or listen to your words, shake off the dust from your feet as you leave that house or town.
verses.heading: The Mission of the Twelve

verses.text: Truly, I say to you, it shall be more tolerable on the day of judgment for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah than for that town.
verses.heading: The Mission of the Twelve

verses.text: “Behold, I send you out as sheep in the midst of wolves; so be wise as serpents and innocent as doves.
verses.heading: Coming Persecutions

verses.text: Beware of men; for they will deliver you up to councils, and flog you in their synagogues,
verses.heading: Coming Persecutions

verses.text: and you will be dragged before governors and kings for my sake, to bear testimony before them and the Gentiles.
verses.heading: Coming Persecutions

verses.text: When they deliver you up, do not be anxious about how you are to speak or what you are to say; for what you are to say will be given to you in that hour;
verses.heading: Coming Persecutions

verses.text: for it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.
verses.heading: Coming Persecutions

verses.text: Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child, and children will rise against parents and have them put to death;
verses.heading: Coming Persecutions

verses.text: and you will be hated by all for my name’s sake. But he who endures to the end will be saved.
verses.heading: Coming Persecutions

verses.text: When they persecute you in one town, flee to the next; for truly, I say to you, you will not have gone through all the towns of Israel, before the Son of man comes.
verses.heading: Coming Persecutions

verses.text: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his master;
verses.heading: Coming Persecutions

verses.text: it is enough for the disciple to be like his teacher, and the servant like his master. If they have called the master of the house Be-elzebul, how much more will they malign those of his household.
verses.heading: Coming Persecutions

verses.text: “So have no fear of them; for nothing is covered that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.
verses.heading: Whom to Fear

verses.text: What I tell you in the dark, utter in the light; and what you hear whispered, proclaim upon the housetops.
verses.heading: Whom to Fear

verses.text: And do not fear those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul; rather fear him who can destroy both soul and body in hell.
verses.heading: Whom to Fear

verses.text: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? And not one of them will fall to the ground without your Father’s will.
verses.heading: Whom to Fear

verses.text: But even the hairs of your head are all numbered.
verses.heading: Whom to Fear

verses.text: Fear not, therefore; you are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.heading: Whom to Fear

verses.text: So every one who acknowledges me before men, I also will acknowledge before my Father who is in heaven;
verses.heading: Whom to Fear

verses.text: but whoever denies me before men, I also will deny before my Father who is in heaven.
verses.heading: Whom to Fear

verses.text: “Do not think that I have come to bring peace on earth; I have not come to bring peace, but a sword.
verses.heading: Taking Up One’s Cross

verses.text: For I have come to set a man against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law;
verses.heading: Taking Up One’s Cross

verses.text: and a man’s foes will be those of his own household.
verses.heading: Taking Up One’s Cross

verses.text: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me;
verses.heading: Taking Up One’s Cross

verses.text: and he who does not take his cross and follow me is not worthy of me.
verses.heading: Taking Up One’s Cross

verses.text: He who finds his life will lose it, and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.
verses.heading: Taking Up One’s Cross

verses.text: “He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.
verses.heading: Rewards

verses.text: He who receives a prophet because he is a prophet shall receive a prophet’s reward, and he who receives a righteous man because he is a righteous man shall receive a righteous man’s reward.
verses.heading: Rewards

verses.text: And whoever gives to one of these little ones even a cup of cold water because he is a disciple, truly, I say to you, he shall not lose his reward.”
verses.heading: Rewards

verses.text: And when Jesus had finished instructing his twelve disciples, he went on from there to teach and preach in their cities.
Now when John heard in prison about the deeds of the Christ, he sent word by his disciples
verses.heading: Messengers from John the Baptist

verses.text: and said to him, “Are you he who is to come, or shall we look for another?”
verses.heading: Messengers from John the Baptist

verses.text: And Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John what you hear and see:
verses.heading: Messengers from John the Baptist

verses.text: the blind receive their sight and the lame walk, lepers are cleansed and the deaf hear, and the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.
verses.heading: Messengers from John the Baptist

verses.text: And blessed is he who takes no offense at me.”
verses.heading: Messengers from John the Baptist

verses.text: As they went away, Jesus began to speak to the crowds concerning John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to behold? A reed shaken by the wind?
verses.heading: Jesus Praises John the Baptist

verses.text: Why then did you go out? To see a man dressed in soft robes? Behold, those who wear soft robes are in kings’ houses.
verses.heading: Jesus Praises John the Baptist

verses.text: Why then did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
verses.heading: Jesus Praises John the Baptist

verses.text: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who shall prepare your way before you.’
verses.heading: Jesus Praises John the Baptist

verses.text: Truly, I say to you, among those born of women there has arisen no one greater than John the Baptist; yet he who is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
verses.heading: Jesus Praises John the Baptist

verses.text: From the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven has suffered violence, and men of violence take it by force.
verses.heading: Jesus Praises John the Baptist

verses.text: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John;
verses.heading: Jesus Praises John the Baptist

verses.text: and if you are willing to accept it, he is Elijah who is to come.
verses.heading: Jesus Praises John the Baptist

verses.text: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.heading: Jesus Praises John the Baptist

verses.text: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the market places and calling to their playmates,
verses.heading: Jesus Praises John the Baptist

verses.text: ‘We piped to you, and you did not dance; we wailed, and you did not mourn.’
verses.heading: Jesus Praises John the Baptist

verses.text: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon’;
verses.heading: Jesus Praises John the Baptist

verses.text: the Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ Yet wisdom is justified by her deeds.”
verses.heading: Jesus Praises John the Baptist

verses.text: Then he began to upbraid the cities where most of his mighty works had been done, because they did not repent.
verses.heading: Jesus Upbraids the Unrepentant Cities

verses.text: “Woe to you, Chorazin! woe to you, Beth-saida! for if the mighty works done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.heading: Jesus Upbraids the Unrepentant Cities

verses.text: But I tell you, it shall be more tolerable on the day of judgment for Tyre and Sidon than for you.
verses.heading: Jesus Upbraids the Unrepentant Cities

verses.text: And you, Caperna-um, will you be exalted to heaven? You shall be brought down to Hades. For if the mighty works done in you had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
verses.heading: Jesus Upbraids the Unrepentant Cities

verses.text: But I tell you that it shall be more tolerable on the day of judgment for the land of Sodom than for you.”
verses.heading: Jesus Upbraids the Unrepentant Cities

verses.text: At that time Jesus declared, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding and revealed them to infants;
verses.heading: Jesus Thanks His Father

verses.text: yes, Father, for such was your gracious will.
verses.heading: Jesus Thanks His Father

verses.text: All things have been delivered to me by my Father; and no one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and any one to whom the Son chooses to reveal him.
verses.heading: Jesus Thanks His Father

verses.text: Come to me, all who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
verses.heading: Jesus Thanks His Father

verses.text: Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me; for I am gentle and lowly in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
verses.heading: Jesus Thanks His Father

verses.text: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
verses.heading: Jesus Thanks His Father

headings.title: The Man with a Withered Hand
The Return of the Unclean Spirit

verses.text: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the sabbath; his disciples were hungry, and they began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.
verses.heading: Plucking Grain on the Sabbath

verses.text: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said to him, “Look, your disciples are doing what is not lawful to do on the sabbath.”
verses.heading: Plucking Grain on the Sabbath

verses.text: He said to them, “Have you not read what David did, when he was hungry, and those who were with him:
verses.heading: Plucking Grain on the Sabbath

verses.text: how he entered the house of God and ate the showbread, which it was not lawful for him to eat nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?
verses.heading: Plucking Grain on the Sabbath

verses.text: Or have you not read in the law how on the sabbath the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are guiltless?
verses.heading: Plucking Grain on the Sabbath

verses.text: I tell you, something greater than the temple is here.
verses.heading: Plucking Grain on the Sabbath

verses.text: And if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the guiltless.
verses.heading: Plucking Grain on the Sabbath

verses.text: For the Son of man is lord of the sabbath.”
verses.heading: Plucking Grain on the Sabbath

verses.text: And he went on from there, and entered their synagogue.
verses.heading: The Man with a Withered Hand

verses.text: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. And they asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath?” so that they might accuse him.
verses.heading: The Man with a Withered Hand

verses.text: He said to them, “What man of you, if he has one sheep and it falls into a pit on the sabbath, will not lay hold of it and lift it out?
verses.heading: The Man with a Withered Hand

verses.text: Of how much more value is a man than a sheep! So it is lawful to do good on the sabbath.”
verses.heading: The Man with a Withered Hand

verses.text: Then he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” And the man stretched it out, and it was restored, whole like the other.
verses.heading: The Man with a Withered Hand

verses.text: But the Pharisees went out and took counsel against him, how to destroy him.
verses.heading: The Man with a Withered Hand

verses.text: Jesus, aware of this, withdrew from there. And many followed him, and he healed them all,
verses.heading: God’s Chosen Servant

verses.text: and ordered them not to make him known.
verses.heading: God’s Chosen Servant

verses.text: This was to fulfil what was spoken by the prophet Isaiah:
verses.heading: God’s Chosen Servant

verses.text: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved with whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit upon him, and he shall proclaim justice to the Gentiles.
verses.heading: God’s Chosen Servant

verses.text: He will not wrangle or cry aloud, nor will any one hear his voice in the streets;
verses.heading: God’s Chosen Servant

verses.text: he will not break a bruised reed or quench a smoldering wick, till he brings justice to victory;
verses.heading: God’s Chosen Servant

verses.text: and in his name will the Gentiles hope.”
verses.heading: God’s Chosen Servant

verses.text: Then a blind and mute demoniac was brought to him, and he healed him, so that the mute man spoke and saw.
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: And all the people were amazed, and said, “Can this be the Son of David?”
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: But when the Pharisees heard it they said, “It is only by Be-elzebul, the prince of demons, that this man casts out demons.”
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: Knowing their thoughts, he said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is laid waste, and no city or house divided against itself will stand;
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: and if Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself; how then will his kingdom stand?
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: And if I cast out demons by Be-elzebul, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore they shall be your judges.
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: But if it is by the Spirit of God that I cast out demons, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: Or how can one enter a strong man’s house and plunder his goods, unless he first binds the strong man? Then indeed he may plunder his house.
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: He who is not with me is against me, and he who does not gather with me scatters.
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: And whoever says a word against the Son of man will be forgiven; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the age to come.
verses.heading: Jesus and Beelzebul

verses.text: “Either make the tree good, and its fruit good; or make the tree bad, and its fruit bad; for the tree is known by its fruit.
verses.heading: A Tree and Its Fruit

verses.text: You brood of vipers! how can you speak good things, when you are evil? For out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.
verses.heading: A Tree and Its Fruit

verses.text: The good man out of his good treasure brings forth good, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings forth evil.
verses.heading: A Tree and Its Fruit

verses.text: I tell you, on the day of judgment men will render account for every careless word they utter;
verses.heading: A Tree and Its Fruit

verses.text: for by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”
verses.heading: A Tree and Its Fruit

verses.text: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees said to him, “Teacher, we wish to see a sign from you.”
verses.heading: The Sign of Jonah

verses.text: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks for a sign; but no sign shall be given to it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
verses.heading: The Sign of Jonah

verses.text: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the whale, so will the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
verses.heading: The Sign of Jonah

verses.text: The men of Nineveh will arise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and behold, something greater than Jonah is here.
verses.heading: The Sign of Jonah

verses.text: The queen of the South will arise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and behold, something greater than Solomon is here.
verses.heading: The Sign of Jonah

verses.text: “When the unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, but he finds none.
verses.heading: The Return of the Unclean Spirit

verses.text: Then he says, ‘I will return to my house from which I came.’ And when he comes he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.
verses.heading: The Return of the Unclean Spirit

verses.text: Then he goes and brings with him seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter and dwell there; and the last state of that man becomes worse than the first. So shall it be also with this evil generation.”
verses.heading: The Return of the Unclean Spirit

verses.text: While he was still speaking to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood outside, asking to speak to him.
verses.heading: The True Kindred of Jesus

verses.text: But he replied to the man who told him, “Who is my mother, and who are my brethren?”
verses.heading: The True Kindred of Jesus

verses.text: And stretching out his hand toward his disciples, he said, “Here are my mother and my brethren!
verses.heading: The True Kindred of Jesus

verses.text: For whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother, and sister, and mother.”
verses.heading: The True Kindred of Jesus
