verses.text: Jesus left the temple and was going away, when his disciples came to point out to him the buildings of the temple.
verses.heading: The Destruction of the Temple Foretold

verses.text: But he answered them, “You see all these, do you not? Truly, I say to you, there will not be left here one stone upon another, that will not be thrown down.”
verses.heading: The Destruction of the Temple Foretold

verses.text: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will this be, and what will be the sign of your coming and of the close of the age?”
verses.heading: Signs of Jesus’ Coming and of the Close of the Age

verses.text: And Jesus answered them, “Take heed that no one leads you astray.
verses.heading: Signs of Jesus’ Coming and of the Close of the Age

verses.text: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and they will lead many astray.
verses.heading: Signs of Jesus’ Coming and of the Close of the Age

verses.text: And you will hear of wars and rumors of wars; see that you are not alarmed; for this must take place, but the end is not yet.
verses.heading: Signs of Jesus’ Coming and of the Close of the Age

verses.text: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom, and there will be famines and earthquakes in various places:
verses.heading: Signs of Jesus’ Coming and of the Close of the Age

verses.text: all this is but the beginning of the sufferings.
verses.heading: Signs of Jesus’ Coming and of the Close of the Age

verses.text: “Then they will deliver you up to tribulation, and put you to death; and you will be hated by all nations for my name’s sake.
verses.heading: Persecutions Foretold

verses.text: And then many will fall away, and betray one another, and hate one another.
verses.heading: Persecutions Foretold

verses.text: And many false prophets will arise and lead many astray.
verses.heading: Persecutions Foretold

verses.text: And because wickedness is multiplied, most men’s love will grow cold.
verses.heading: Persecutions Foretold

verses.text: But he who endures to the end will be saved.
verses.heading: Persecutions Foretold

verses.text: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached throughout the whole world, as a testimony to all nations; and then the end will come.
verses.heading: Persecutions Foretold

verses.text: “So when you see the desolating sacrilege spoken of by the prophet Daniel, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains;
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: let him who is on the housetop not go down to take what is in his house;
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: and let him who is in the field not turn back to get a coat.
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: And alas for those who are with child and for those who are nursing in those days!
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: Pray that your flight may not be in winter or on a sabbath.
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: For then there will be great tribulation, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, and never will be.
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: And if those days had not been shortened, no human being would be saved; but for the sake of the elect those days will be shortened.
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: Then if any one says to you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There he is!’ do not believe it.
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: For false Christs and false prophets will arise and show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the elect.
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: Behold, I have told you beforehand.
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: So, if they say to you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ do not go out; if they say, ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: For as the lightning comes from the east and shines as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of man.
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: Wherever the body is, there the eagles will be gathered together.
verses.heading: The Desolating Sacrilege

verses.text: “Immediately after the tribulation of those days the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light, and the stars will fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;
verses.heading: The Coming of the Son of Man

verses.text: then will appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven, and then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory;
verses.heading: The Coming of the Son of Man

verses.text: and he will send out his angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
verses.heading: The Coming of the Son of Man

verses.text: “From the fig tree learn its lesson: as soon as its branch becomes tender and puts forth its leaves, you know that summer is near.
verses.heading: The Lesson of the Fig Tree

verses.text: So also, when you see all these things, you know that he is near, at the very gates.
verses.heading: The Lesson of the Fig Tree

verses.text: Truly, I say to you, this generation will not pass away till all these things take place.
verses.heading: The Lesson of the Fig Tree

verses.text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
verses.heading: The Lesson of the Fig Tree

verses.text: “But of that day and hour no one knows, not even the angels of heaven, nor the Son, but the Father only.
verses.heading: The Necessity for Watchfulness

verses.text: As were the days of Noah, so will be the coming of the Son of man.
verses.heading: The Necessity for Watchfulness

verses.text: For as in those days before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day when Noah entered the ark,
verses.heading: The Necessity for Watchfulness

verses.text: and they did not know until the flood came and swept them all away, so will be the coming of the Son of man.
verses.heading: The Necessity for Watchfulness

verses.text: Then two men will be in the field; one is taken and one is left.
verses.heading: The Necessity for Watchfulness

verses.text: Two women will be grinding at the mill; one is taken and one is left.
verses.heading: The Necessity for Watchfulness

verses.text: Watch therefore, for you do not know on what day your Lord is coming.
verses.heading: The Necessity for Watchfulness

verses.text: But know this, that if the householder had known in what part of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched and would not have let his house be broken into.
verses.heading: The Necessity for Watchfulness

verses.text: Therefore you also must be ready; for the Son of man is coming at an hour you do not expect.
verses.heading: The Necessity for Watchfulness

verses.text: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his master has set over his household, to give them their food at the proper time?
verses.heading: The Faithful and the Unfaithful Servant

verses.text: Blessed is that servant whom his master when he comes will find so doing.
verses.heading: The Faithful and the Unfaithful Servant

verses.text: Truly, I say to you, he will set him over all his possessions.
verses.heading: The Faithful and the Unfaithful Servant

verses.text: But if that wicked servant says to himself, ‘My master is delayed,’
verses.heading: The Faithful and the Unfaithful Servant

verses.text: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eats and drinks with the drunken,
verses.heading: The Faithful and the Unfaithful Servant

verses.text: the master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he does not know,
verses.heading: The Faithful and the Unfaithful Servant

verses.text: and will punish him, and put him with the hypocrites; there men will weep and gnash their teeth.
verses.heading: The Faithful and the Unfaithful Servant

headings.title: The Parable of the Wise and the Foolish Maidens

verses.text: “Then the kingdom of heaven shall be compared to ten maidens who took their lamps and went to meet the bridegroom.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wise and the Foolish Maidens

verses.text: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wise and the Foolish Maidens

verses.text: For when the foolish took their lamps, they took no oil with them;
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wise and the Foolish Maidens

verses.text: but the wise took flasks of oil with their lamps.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wise and the Foolish Maidens

verses.text: As the bridegroom was delayed, they all slumbered and slept.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wise and the Foolish Maidens

verses.text: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold, the bridegroom! Come out to meet him.’
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wise and the Foolish Maidens

verses.text: Then all those maidens rose and trimmed their lamps.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wise and the Foolish Maidens

verses.text: And the foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wise and the Foolish Maidens

verses.text: But the wise replied, ‘Perhaps there will not be enough for us and for you; go rather to the dealers and buy for yourselves.’
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wise and the Foolish Maidens

verses.text: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the marriage feast; and the door was shut.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wise and the Foolish Maidens

verses.text: Afterward the other maidens came also, saying, ‘Lord, lord, open to us.’
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wise and the Foolish Maidens

verses.text: But he replied, ‘Truly, I say to you, I do not know you.’
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wise and the Foolish Maidens

verses.text: Watch therefore, for you know neither the day nor the hour.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Wise and the Foolish Maidens

verses.text: “For it will be as when a man going on a journey called his servants and entrusted to them his property;
verses.heading: The Parable of the Talents

verses.text: to one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his ability. Then he went away.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Talents

verses.text: He who had received the five talents went at once and traded with them; and he made five talents more.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Talents

verses.text: So also, he who had the two talents made two talents more.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Talents

verses.text: But he who had received the one talent went and dug in the ground and hid his master’s money.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Talents

verses.text: Now after a long time the master of those servants came and settled accounts with them.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Talents

verses.text: And he who had received the five talents came forward, bringing five talents more, saying, ‘Master, you delivered to me five talents; here I have made five talents more.’
verses.heading: The Parable of the Talents

verses.text: His master said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant; you have been faithful over a little, I will set you over much; enter into the joy of your master.’
verses.heading: The Parable of the Talents

verses.text: And he also who had the two talents came forward, saying, ‘Master, you delivered to me two talents; here I have made two talents more.’
verses.heading: The Parable of the Talents

verses.text: His master said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant; you have been faithful over a little, I will set you over much; enter into the joy of your master.’
verses.heading: The Parable of the Talents

verses.text: He also who had received the one talent came forward, saying, ‘Master, I knew you to be a hard man, reaping where you did not sow, and gathering where you did not winnow;
verses.heading: The Parable of the Talents

verses.text: so I was afraid, and I went and hid your talent in the ground. Here you have what is yours.’
verses.heading: The Parable of the Talents

verses.text: But his master answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant! You knew that I reap where I have not sowed, and gather where I have not winnowed?
verses.heading: The Parable of the Talents

verses.text: Then you ought to have invested my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received what was my own with interest.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Talents

verses.text: So take the talent from him, and give it to him who has the ten talents.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Talents

verses.text: For to every one who has will more be given, and he will have abundance; but from him who has not, even what he has will be taken away.
verses.heading: The Parable of the Talents

verses.text: And cast the worthless servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
verses.heading: The Parable of the Talents

verses.text: “When the Son of man comes in his glory, and all the angels with him, then he will sit on his glorious throne.
verses.heading: The Judgment of the Nations

verses.text: Before him will be gathered all the nations, and he will separate them one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats,
verses.heading: The Judgment of the Nations

verses.text: and he will place the sheep at his right hand, but the goats at the left.
verses.heading: The Judgment of the Nations

verses.text: Then the King will say to those at his right hand, ‘Come, O blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;
verses.heading: The Judgment of the Nations

verses.text: for I was hungry and you gave me food, I was thirsty and you gave me drink, I was a stranger and you welcomed me,
verses.heading: The Judgment of the Nations

verses.text: I was naked and you clothed me, I was sick and you visited me, I was in prison and you came to me.’
verses.heading: The Judgment of the Nations

verses.text: Then the righteous will answer him, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you drink?
verses.heading: The Judgment of the Nations

verses.text: And when did we see you a stranger and welcome you, or naked and clothe you?
verses.heading: The Judgment of the Nations

verses.text: And when did we see you sick or in prison and visit you?’
verses.heading: The Judgment of the Nations

verses.text: And the King will answer them, ‘Truly, I say to you, as you did it to one of the least of these my brethren, you did it to me.’
verses.heading: The Judgment of the Nations

verses.text: Then he will say to those at his left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels;
verses.heading: The Judgment of the Nations

verses.text: for I was hungry and you gave me no food, I was thirsty and you gave me no drink,
verses.heading: The Judgment of the Nations

verses.text: I was a stranger and you did not welcome me, naked and you did not clothe me, sick and in prison and you did not visit me.’
verses.heading: The Judgment of the Nations

verses.text: Then they also will answer, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and did not minister to you?’
verses.heading: The Judgment of the Nations

verses.text: Then he will answer them, ‘Truly, I say to you, as you did it not to one of the least of these, you did it not to me.’
verses.heading: The Judgment of the Nations

verses.text: And they will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
verses.heading: The Judgment of the Nations

headings.title: The Institution of the Last Supper
The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: When Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said to his disciples,
verses.heading: The Conspiracy to Kill Jesus

verses.text: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of man will be delivered up to be crucified.”
verses.heading: The Conspiracy to Kill Jesus

verses.text: Then the chief priests and the elders of the people gathered in the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
verses.heading: The Conspiracy to Kill Jesus

verses.text: and took counsel together in order to arrest Jesus by stealth and kill him.
verses.heading: The Conspiracy to Kill Jesus

verses.text: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest there be a tumult among the people.”
verses.heading: The Conspiracy to Kill Jesus

verses.text: Now when Jesus was at Bethany in the house of Simon the leper,
verses.heading: The Anointing at Bethany

verses.text: a woman came up to him with an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head, as he sat at table.
verses.heading: The Anointing at Bethany

verses.text: But when the disciples saw it, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?
verses.heading: The Anointing at Bethany

verses.text: For this ointment might have been sold for a large sum, and given to the poor.”
verses.heading: The Anointing at Bethany

verses.text: But Jesus, aware of this, said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? For she has done a beautiful thing to me.
verses.heading: The Anointing at Bethany

verses.text: For you always have the poor with you, but you will not always have me.
verses.heading: The Anointing at Bethany

verses.text: In pouring this ointment on my body she has done it to prepare me for burial.
verses.heading: The Anointing at Bethany

verses.text: Truly, I say to you, wherever this gospel is preached in the whole world, what she has done will be told in memory of her.”
verses.heading: The Anointing at Bethany

verses.text: Then one of the Twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests
verses.heading: Judas Agrees to Betray Jesus

verses.text: and said, “What will you give me if I deliver him to you?” And they paid him thirty pieces of silver.
verses.heading: Judas Agrees to Betray Jesus

verses.text: And from that moment he sought an opportunity to betray him.
verses.heading: Judas Agrees to Betray Jesus

verses.text: Now on the first day of Unleavened Bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Where will you have us prepare for you to eat the Passover?”
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: He said, “Go into the city to such a one, and say to him, ‘The Teacher says, My time is at hand; I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.’”
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: And the disciples did as Jesus had directed them, and they prepared the Passover.
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: When it was evening, he sat at table with the twelve disciples;
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: and as they were eating, he said, “Truly, I say to you, one of you will betray me.”
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: And they were very sorrowful, and began to say to him one after another, “Is it I, Lord?”
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: He answered, “He who has dipped his hand in the dish with me, will betray me.
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: The Son of man goes as it is written of him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! It would have been better for that man if he had not been born.”
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: Judas, who betrayed him, said, “Is it I, Master?” He said to him, “You have said so.”
verses.heading: The Passover with the Disciples

verses.text: Now as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and broke it, and gave it to the disciples and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.”
verses.heading: The Institution of the Last Supper

verses.text: And he took a chalice, and when he had given thanks he gave it to them, saying, “Drink of it, all of you;
verses.heading: The Institution of the Last Supper

verses.text: for this is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.
verses.heading: The Institution of the Last Supper

verses.text: I tell you I shall not drink again of this fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom.”
verses.heading: The Institution of the Last Supper

verses.text: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
verses.heading: Peter’s Denial Foretold

verses.text: Then Jesus said to them, “You will all fall away because of me this night; for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
verses.heading: Peter’s Denial Foretold

verses.text: But after I am raised up, I will go before you to Galilee.”
verses.heading: Peter’s Denial Foretold

verses.text: Peter declared to him, “Though they all fall away because of you, I will never fall away.”
verses.heading: Peter’s Denial Foretold

verses.text: Jesus said to him, “Truly, I say to you, this very night, before the cock crows, you will deny me three times.”
verses.heading: Peter’s Denial Foretold

verses.text: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” And so said all the disciples.
verses.heading: Peter’s Denial Foretold

verses.text: Then Jesus went with them to a place called Gethsemane, and he said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go over there and pray.”
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: And taking with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, he began to be sorrowful and troubled.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: Then he said to them, “My soul is very sorrowful, even to death; remain here, and watch with me.”
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: And going a little farther he fell on his face and prayed, “My Father, if it be possible, let this chalice pass from me; nevertheless, not as I will, but as you will.”
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: And he came to the disciples and found them sleeping; and he said to Peter, “So, could you not watch with me one hour?
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: Watch and pray that you may not enter into temptation; the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: Again, for the second time, he went away and prayed, “My Father, if this cannot pass unless I drink it, your will be done.”
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: And again he came and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: So, leaving them again, he went away and prayed for the third time, saying the same words.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: Then he came to the disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and taking your rest? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: Rise, let us be going; see, my betrayer is at hand.”
verses.heading: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane

verses.text: While he was still speaking, Judas came, one of the Twelve, and with him a great crowd with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and the elders of the people.
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: Now the betrayer had given them a sign, saying, “The one I shall kiss is the man; seize him.”
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: And he came up to Jesus at once and said, “Hail, Master!” And he kissed him.
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came up and laid hands on Jesus and seized him.
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: And behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the slave of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place; for all who take the sword will perish by the sword.
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: Do you think that I cannot appeal to my Father, and he will at once send me more than twelve legions of angels?
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: But how then should the Scriptures be fulfilled, that it must be so?”
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: At that hour Jesus said to the crowds, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs to capture me? Day after day I sat in the temple teaching, and you did not seize me.
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: But all this has taken place, that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples deserted him and fled.
verses.heading: The Betrayal and Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: Then those who had seized Jesus led him to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders had gathered.
verses.heading: Jesus before the High Priest

verses.text: But Peter followed him at a distance, as far as the courtyard of the high priest, and going inside he sat with the guards to see the end.
verses.heading: Jesus before the High Priest

verses.text: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus that they might put him to death,
verses.heading: Jesus before the High Priest

verses.text: but they found none, though many false witnesses came forward. At last two came forward
verses.heading: Jesus before the High Priest

verses.text: and said, “This fellow said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”
verses.heading: Jesus before the High Priest

verses.text: And the high priest stood up and said, “Have you no answer to make? What is it that these men testify against you?”
verses.heading: Jesus before the High Priest

verses.text: But Jesus was silent. And the high priest said to him, “I adjure you by the living God, tell us if you are the Christ, the Son of God.”
verses.heading: Jesus before the High Priest

verses.text: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. But I tell you, hereafter you will see the Son of man seated at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of heaven.”
verses.heading: Jesus before the High Priest

verses.text: Then the high priest tore his robes, and said, “He has uttered blasphemy. Why do we still need witnesses? You have now heard his blasphemy.
verses.heading: Jesus before the High Priest

verses.text: What is your judgment?” They answered, “He deserves death.”
verses.heading: Jesus before the High Priest

verses.text: Then they spat in his face, and struck him; and some slapped him,
verses.heading: Jesus before the High Priest

verses.text: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who is it that struck you?”
verses.heading: Jesus before the High Priest

verses.text: Now Peter was sitting outside in the courtyard. And a maid came up to him, and said, “You also were with Jesus the Galilean.”
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

verses.text: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I do not know what you mean.”
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

verses.text: And when he went out to the porch, another maid saw him, and she said to the bystanders, “This man was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

verses.text: And again he denied it with an oath, “I do not know the man.”
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

verses.text: After a little while the bystanders came up and said to Peter, “Certainly you are also one of them, for your accent betrays you.”
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

verses.text: Then he began to invoke a curse on himself and to swear, “I do not know the man.” And immediately the cock crowed.
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

verses.text: And Peter remembered the saying of Jesus, “Before the cock crows, you will deny me three times.” And he went out and wept bitterly.
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

headings.title: Pilate Delivers Jesus to Be Crucified

verses.text: When morning came, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death;
verses.heading: Jesus Brought before Pilate

verses.text: and they bound him and led him away and delivered him to Pilate the governor.
verses.heading: Jesus Brought before Pilate

verses.text: When Judas, his betrayer, saw that he was condemned, he repented and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and the elders,
verses.heading: Judas Hangs Himself

verses.text: saying, “I have sinned in betraying innocent blood.” They said, “What is that to us? See to it yourself.”
verses.heading: Judas Hangs Himself

verses.text: And throwing down the pieces of silver in the temple, he departed; and he went and hanged himself.
verses.heading: Judas Hangs Himself

verses.text: But the chief priests, taking the pieces of silver, said, “It is not lawful to put them into the treasury, since they are blood money.”
verses.heading: Judas Hangs Himself

verses.text: So they took counsel, and bought with them the potter’s field, to bury strangers in.
verses.heading: Judas Hangs Himself

verses.text: Therefore that field has been called the Field of Blood to this day.
verses.heading: Judas Hangs Himself

verses.text: Then was fulfilled what had been spoken by the prophet Jeremiah, saying, “And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him on whom a price had been set by some of the sons of Israel,
verses.heading: Judas Hangs Himself

verses.text: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord directed me.”
verses.heading: Judas Hangs Himself

verses.text: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “You have said so.”
verses.heading: Pilate Questions Jesus

verses.text: But when he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he made no answer.
verses.heading: Pilate Questions Jesus

verses.text: Then Pilate said to him, “Do you not hear how many things they testify against you?”
verses.heading: Pilate Questions Jesus

verses.text: But he gave him no answer, not even to a single charge; so that the governor wondered greatly.
verses.heading: Pilate Questions Jesus

verses.text: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release for the crowd any one prisoner whom they wanted.
verses.heading: Barabbas or Jesus?

verses.text: And they had then a notorious prisoner, called Barabbas.
verses.heading: Barabbas or Jesus?

verses.text: So when they had gathered, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release for you, Barabbas or Jesus who is called Christ?”
verses.heading: Barabbas or Jesus?

verses.text: For he knew that it was out of envy that they had delivered him up.
verses.heading: Barabbas or Jesus?

verses.text: Besides, while he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent word to him, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered much over him today in a dream.”
verses.heading: Barabbas or Jesus?

verses.text: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the people to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.
verses.heading: Barabbas or Jesus?

verses.text: The governor again said to them, “Which of the two do you want me to release for you?” And they said, “Barabbas.”
verses.heading: Barabbas or Jesus?

verses.text: Pilate said to them, “Then what shall I do with Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said, “Let him be crucified.”
verses.heading: Barabbas or Jesus?

verses.text: And he said, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they shouted all the more, “Let him be crucified.”
verses.heading: Barabbas or Jesus?

verses.text: So when Pilate saw that he was gaining nothing, but rather that a riot was beginning, he took water and washed his hands before the crowd, saying, “I am innocent of this righteous man’s blood; see to it yourselves.”
verses.heading: Pilate Delivers Jesus to Be Crucified

verses.text: And all the people answered, “His blood be on us and on our children!”
verses.heading: Pilate Delivers Jesus to Be Crucified

verses.text: Then he released for them Barabbas, and having scourged Jesus, delivered him to be crucified.
verses.heading: Pilate Delivers Jesus to Be Crucified

verses.text: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the praetorium, and they gathered the whole battalion before him.
verses.heading: The Soldiers Mock Jesus

verses.text: And they stripped him and put a scarlet robe upon him,
verses.heading: The Soldiers Mock Jesus

verses.text: and plaiting a crown of thorns they put it on his head, and put a reed in his right hand. And kneeling before him they mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
verses.heading: The Soldiers Mock Jesus

verses.text: And they spat upon him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.
verses.heading: The Soldiers Mock Jesus

verses.text: And when they had mocked him, they stripped him of the robe, and put his own clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.
verses.heading: The Soldiers Mock Jesus

verses.text: As they were marching out, they came upon a man of Cyrene, Simon by name; this man they compelled to carry his cross.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: And when they came to a place called Golgotha (which means the place of a skull),
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: they offered him wine to drink, mingled with gall; but when he tasted it, he would not drink it.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: And when they had crucified him, they divided his garments among them by casting lots;
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: then they sat down and kept watch over him there.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: And over his head they put the charge against him, which read, “This is Jesus the King of the Jews.”
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: Then two robbers were crucified with him, one on the right and one on the left.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: And those who passed by derided him, wagging their heads
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: and saying, “You who would destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross.”
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: So also the chief priests, with the scribes and elders, mocked him, saying,
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: “He saved others; he cannot save himself. He is the King of Israel; let him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in him.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: He trusts in God; let God deliver him now, if he desires him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: And the robbers who were crucified with him also reviled him in the same way.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion of Jesus

verses.text: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, “Eli, Eli, lama sabach-thani?” that is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: And some of the bystanders hearing it said, “This man is calling Elijah.”
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: And one of them at once ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave it to him to drink.
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: But the others said, “Wait, let us see whether Elijah will come to save him.”
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: And Jesus cried again with a loud voice and yielded up his spirit.
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: And behold, the curtain of the temple was torn in two, from top to bottom; and the earth shook, and the rocks were split;
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: the tombs also were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised,
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection they went into the holy city and appeared to many.
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: When the centurion and those who were with him, keeping watch over Jesus, saw the earthquake and what took place, they were filled with awe, and said, “Truly this was the Son of God!”
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: There were also many women there, looking on from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering to him;
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: among whom were Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
verses.heading: The Death of Jesus

verses.text: When it was evening, there came a rich man from Arimathea, named Joseph, who also was a disciple of Jesus.
verses.heading: The Burial of Jesus

verses.text: He went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus. Then Pilate ordered it to be given to him.
verses.heading: The Burial of Jesus

verses.text: And Joseph took the body, and wrapped it in a clean linen shroud,
verses.heading: The Burial of Jesus

verses.text: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn in the rock; and he rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb, and departed.
verses.heading: The Burial of Jesus

verses.text: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were there, sitting opposite the tomb.
verses.heading: The Burial of Jesus

verses.text: Next day, that is, after the day of Preparation, the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered before Pilate
verses.heading: The Guard at the Tomb

verses.text: and said, “Sir, we remember how that impostor said, while he was still alive, ‘After three days I will rise again.’
verses.heading: The Guard at the Tomb

verses.text: Therefore order the tomb to be made secure until the third day, lest his disciples go and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He has risen from the dead,’ and the last fraud will be worse than the first.”
verses.heading: The Guard at the Tomb

verses.text: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard of soldiers; go, make it as secure as you can.”
verses.heading: The Guard at the Tomb

verses.text: So they went and made the tomb secure by sealing the stone and setting a guard.
verses.heading: The Guard at the Tomb

verses.text: Now after the sabbath, toward the dawn of the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: And behold, there was a great earthquake; for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven and came and rolled back the stone, and sat upon it.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: And for fear of him the guards trembled and became like dead men.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: But the angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid; for I know that you seek Jesus who was crucified.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: He is not here; for he has risen, as he said. Come, see the place where he lay.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: Then go quickly and tell his disciples that he has risen from the dead, and behold, he is going before you to Galilee; there you will see him. Behold, I have told you.”
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: So they departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to tell his disciples.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: And behold, Jesus met them and said, “Hail!” And they came up and took hold of his feet and worshiped him.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: Then Jesus said to them, “Do not be afraid; go and tell my brethren to go to Galilee, and there they will see me.”
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: While they were going, behold, some of the guard went into the city and told the chief priests all that had taken place.
verses.heading: The Report of the Guard

verses.text: And when they had assembled with the elders and taken counsel, they gave a sum of money to the soldiers
verses.heading: The Report of the Guard

verses.text: and said, “Tell people, ‘His disciples came by night and stole him away while we were asleep.’
verses.heading: The Report of the Guard

verses.text: And if this comes to the governor’s ears, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.”
verses.heading: The Report of the Guard

verses.text: So they took the money and did as they were directed; and this story has been spread among the Jews to this day.
verses.heading: The Report of the Guard

verses.text: Now the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain to which Jesus had directed them.
verses.heading: Jesus Commissions the Disciples

verses.text: And when they saw him they worshiped him; but some doubted.
verses.heading: Jesus Commissions the Disciples

verses.text: And Jesus came and said to them, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.
verses.heading: Jesus Commissions the Disciples

verses.text: Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
verses.heading: Jesus Commissions the Disciples

verses.text: teaching them to observe all that I have commanded you; and behold, I am with you always, to the close of the age.”
verses.heading: Jesus Commissions the Disciples
